subject: gk
question: According to 2011 census of India, what is the urban population as percentage of total population?
solution:
The correct answer is __**31.2 percent**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__ As per Census 2011__-

__
 
• It conducted by the Registrar General of India, the total number of agricultural workers in the country have increased from 234.1 million (127.3 million cultivators and 106.8 million agricultural labourers) in 2001 to 263.1 million (118.8 million cultivators and 144.3 million agricultural labourers) in 2011.
 
• So the number of farmers has decreased while the number of agricultural labourers has increased from 2001 to 2011. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Census in India:

 
• It was done for the first time in 1872 under the British Viceroy Lord Mayo.
 
• After that, it is conducted at intervals every 10 years.
 
• However, the first complete census of India was conducted in 1881.
 
• Since 1949, it is conducted by the Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India under the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India.
 
• All censuses after 1951 were conducted under the 1948 Census Act.
 
• As of 2011, the Census of India has been conducted 15 times.
